title: Pumpkin Crumb Cake
description: A moist pumpkin cake topped with a crispy spiced streusel and finished with an optional sweet glaze, perfect for fall baking.

steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 350°F and line an 8-inch square or 9-inch round baking pan with parchment paper after spraying with nonstick cooking spray.
Make the streusel by combining 1/2 cup brown sugar, 1/2 cup flour, 1 teaspoon pumpkin spice, and a pinch of salt in a small bowl.
Add the cold cubed butter and work it into the dry ingredients with your fingertips until pebble-sized crumbs form.
In a large bowl, whisk 1 cup brown sugar and the eggs until pale and foamy, about 1 minute.
Add the pumpkin purée, melted butter, oil, pumpkin spice, and salt, then whisk until smooth.
Whisk in the baking powder and baking soda, then stir in the flour until fully combined.
Pour the batter into the prepared pan, smooth the top, and tap the pan lightly to release air bubbles.
Sprinkle the streusel evenly over the top.
Bake for 40 to 45 minutes, until golden and a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.
Cool in the pan for 15 minutes, then remove and cool almost completely on a wire rack.
If making the glaze, whisk together the confectioners' sugar, pumpkin spice, salt, and 3 teaspoons milk, adding more milk as needed until thick but drizzleable.
Drizzle the glaze over the slightly warm cake and serve.
